data.title: Did Aristotle exist? China targets pseudo-history myths claiming West stole civilisations
data.description: BEIJING — A provincial propaganda department in China has warned the public against subscribing to growing conspiracy theories on history, such as those stating that Aristotle and Ancient Greece never existed.

data.title: US backs Japan over Putin trip to disputed islands
data.description: TOKYO — The United States recognises Japan's sovereignty over islands visited by Russian President Vladimir Putin, the US ambassador to Tokyo said Friday.

data.title: US, Mexico conduct security exercises near border
data.description: CIUDAD JUáREZ (MEXICO) - US and Mexican armed forces performed exercises on Thursday along the border near the cities of El Paso and Ciudad Juarez.

data.title: Thousands stranded at Japan's Narita airport after record rain kills four
data.description: TOKYO — Record rainfall left thousands of travellers stranded at Tokyo's Narita airport on Friday as flooding in the surrounding area disrupted transport, knocked out power ​to homes and ⁠claimed at least four lives.

data.title: 'I want to be Eala': Philippine sensation sparks tennis boom at home
data.description: MANILA - On a Manila court made of crushed seashells, an earnest four-year-old sends a forehand sailing wide –- one of dozens of kids aiming to follow in the footsteps of the Philippines' first homegrown tennis sensation, Alexandra Eala.

data.title: Vance says low oil prices are top US goal in Iran conflict
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Vice President JD Vance said Thursday that the top US priority in the Iran war was keeping oil and gasoline prices low for Americans, with preventing Tehran from acquiring a nuclear weapon ranking second.

data.title: US, Mexico conduct security exercises near border
data.description: CIUDAD JUáREZ (MEXICO) - US and Mexican armed forces performed security exercises Thursday along the border near the cities of El Paso and Ciudad Juarez.

data.title: UK vote count under way in Farage, Binface showdown
data.description: CLACTON-ON-SEA (UNITED KINGDOM) - Vote counting was under way early on Friday after an unusual English by-election shunned by mainstream parties, pitting influential hard-right leader Nigel Farage against Count Binface, a man with a rubbish bin on his head.

data.title: New trend of injecting banned peptides to 'optimise' body
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Thomas's phone alarm buzzes at 9:30 pm -- it's time for the aspiring bodybuilder to start injecting himself in the stomach with several banned peptides.

data.title: 'Shock' gloves for US immigration agents fuel potential abuse fears
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Plans to equip US immigration enforcement agents with gloves capable of delivering debilitating electric shocks have fueled concerns over potential abuses by a force that critics say is already over-zealous and under-trained.

data.title: Trump announces tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump announced on Thursday tariffs of up to 100 percent on imports of unmanned drones and their components to reduce US reliance on imports in an industry dominated by China.

data.title: Israel reopens once-closed West Bank settlement
data.description: GANIM (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Israel officially reopened the West Bank settlement of Ganim on Thursday, more than 20 years after it withdrew from the community, in a move emblematic of the current government's policy of rapid settlement expansion.

data.title: Indicted Raul Castro reappears after months out of public view
data.description: HAVANA - US-indicted Cuban leader Raul Castro received a standing ovation as he appeared in public for the first time in months Thursday, attending an event in Havana to mark the centenary of his brother Fidel's birth.

data.title: 'Dream come true': Owners reunite with pets in quake-hit Colombia
data.description: CALI (COLOMBIA) - A beaming Vickye Giraldo holds her rescued kitten tight against her chest outside her ruined home in quake-hit Cali, Colombia.

data.title: Twitch sparks gamers' wrath with Amazon AI sharing deal
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Livestream gaming giant Twitch has raised hackles among its millions of users after declaring it will share their data with its parent company Amazon, to better train the online retailer's AI models.

data.title: Blaze forces families to abandon Turkish tour boat
data.description: ISTANBUL — More than 100 people had to abandon ship after a fire engulfed a children's entertainment tour boat off southwestern Turkey on Thursday, officials said.

data.title: 'How many will die?': the mysterious ailment killing Kenyan elephants
data.description: KIMANA (KENYA) - Lying on the ground and kicking up a cloud of dust, an elephant slowly exhausts himself in a futile attempt to stand, the latest potential victim of a still-mysterious ailment in southern Kenya.

data.title: Maghreb sees demographic shift with fertility at historic low
data.description: TUNIS - Economic pressures and changing social norms are driving couples in Tunisia, Morocco, and Algeria to have fewer babies, with a recent study saying Maghreb fertility was at a historic low.

data.title: Romania shuts down nuclear plant as Danube drops
data.description: BUCHAREST - Romania halted operations of its only nuclear plant on Thursday, a rare shutdown due to a drought scorching Europe that has caused the Danube river, whose waters cool the plant, to fall to record lows.

data.title: US ambassador denounces ‘thuggish’ Israeli settlers
data.description: QUSRA, Palestinian Territories - Israeli forces on Thursday moved against rogue settlers who have besieged Palestinians amid unusually strong US criticism, even as Israel inaugurated a major settlement elsewhere in the West Bank.
